changelog:
Initial release of mermaid-maker.

- Generate, validate, render, and export Mermaid diagrams (flowchart, sequence, class, ER, state, gantt, git graph, mindmap, C4, pie, journey).
- Supports three rendering backends: beautiful-mermaid (themed SVG/ASCII, batch), mmdc (PNG/SVG/PDF), and Kroki API (no-install PNG/SVG).
- Theming support with 15 built-in themes for beautiful-mermaid; quick commands and catalog provided.
- Built-in validation, self-check guidance, and review loop for high-quality, readable diagrams.
- Diagram templates and usage guidance for individual diagram types included.
- Designed for diagrams-as-code with automatic layout, ideal for system visuals, API flows, class hierarchies, and database schemas.
